title: Principal Engineer — Test Strategy
description:
About This Role
**18 years of experience**  

**Skills: Test Strategy, Quality Engineering, Test Architecture, Automation Frameworks, Shift\-Left Testing, CI/CD, AI Testing, Performance Testing, API Testing, Selenium / Playwright, Cloud Testing, Stakeholder Management, Agile / SAFe, Mentoring, DevOps**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Principal Engineer — Test Strategy with 18\+ years of experience to define, own, and drive the enterprise\-wide test strategy and quality engineering vision. You will operate at the intersection of technology leadership, quality architecture, and stakeholder engagement — setting the standards, frameworks, and practices that underpin software quality across the organisation. This is a senior leadership role requiring deep QE expertise, strong strategic thinking, and the ability to influence at the highest levels of the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Define and own the enterprise\-wide test strategy — establishing quality engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices across all delivery programmes.
* Design and govern test architecture — automation frameworks, tooling standards, CI/CD quality gates, and shift\-left testing adoption across engineering teams.
* Lead quality engineering transformation initiatives — driving adoption of AI\-augmented testing, intelligent automation, and modern QE practices across the organisation.
* Establish and maintain QE governance — quality metrics, test coverage standards, reporting frameworks, and release quality sign\-off processes.
* Engage senior stakeholders — CTO, engineering directors, product leadership — presenting quality strategy, risk assessments, and programme quality status with authority.
* Define and oversee non\-functional testing strategy — performance, security, accessibility, and resilience testing standards across enterprise platforms.
* Lead and mentor a community of QE professionals — coaching test leads, automation engineers, and SDETs across multiple delivery teams.
* Contribute to technology strategy — advising on tooling investments, platform quality capabilities, and emerging QE trends including AI / GenAI testing.
* Drive continuous improvement — identifying systemic quality issues, implementing root cause analysis frameworks, and delivering measurable quality improvements.

**What We're Looking For**


* 18\+ years of quality engineering experience with a proven track record of defining and delivering enterprise\-wide test strategies at scale.


* Deep expertise across the full QE spectrum — functional, automation, performance, security, API, and AI / GenAI testing.


* Strong test architecture skills — designing automation frameworks, tooling standards, and CI/CD quality integration across large\-scale delivery organisations.


* Proven ability to define and govern QE standards — quality metrics, test coverage frameworks, and release quality governance.


* Strong leadership and mentoring capability — developing QE talent, coaching senior engineers, and building high\-performing quality engineering communities.


* Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills — influencing CTO, engineering directors, and product leadership with clarity and authority.


* Deep Agile / SAFe delivery knowledge — embedding quality engineering practices across large\-scale Agile programmes.


* Strong understanding of AI / GenAI testing — LLM evaluation, RAG pipeline testing, and AI\-augmented test automation.


* Commercially aware — understanding the business impact of quality risk and using this to drive pragmatic, risk\-proportionate quality decisions.


Apply now

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Key Responsibilities:**


Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test strategies.


Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver in Java.


Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Implement and maintain test automation frameworks (e.g., Page Object Model, TestNG/JUnit, Cucumber BDD) to ensure efficient and organized testing.


Execute automated tests, analyze results, and identify defects, working closely with development teams for resolution.


Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) to support agile development practices.


Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, smoke, sanity and integration testing, leveraging automation where appropriate.


Conduct API testing using tools like Postman or Swagger to validate backend services.


Perform database validation by writing and executing SQL queries to ensure data integrity.


Participate in code reviews of test automation scripts to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.


Provide clear and concise reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall product quality to stakeholders.


Continuously research and implement new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.


Contribute to the improvement of overall software quality processes and practices within the team.


Required Skills \& Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


6\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance with a strong focus on test automation.


Proficient in designing and developing automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver.


Strong programming skills in at least one object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#).


Experience with test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, Pytest, NUnit, or similar.


Solid understanding and practical experience with the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern.


Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.


Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


Knowledge of SQL for database validation.


Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in an agile environment.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


Experience with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber.


Knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).


Experience with security testing concepts and tools.


Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Understanding of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Relevant certifications in Quality Assurance or test automation.


Experience with mobile application test automation.


Education \& Certifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.


Industry certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

title: Quality and Automation Engineer 2
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


This job focuses on the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts, ensuring alignment with software engineering standards. The role requires executing tests, analyzing results, and reporting defects to enhance product quality. Key responsibilities include collaborating with developers to integrate testing strategies, crafting detailed documentation, and contributing to code reviews. The position requires staying current with test automation advancements and repairing scripts of intermediate complexity with some guidance.**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

* Developing and maintaining automated test scripts in alignment with software engineering standards
* Executing automated tests, analyzing outcomes, and reporting defects for product enhancement
* Diagnosing and repairing malfunctioning test cases to ensure continuous reliability
* Collaborating with development teams to integrate test automation strategies from the outset
* Crafting documentation for automated testing, including comprehensive test plans and reports
* Contributing to code reviews and sharing automated testing expertise within the team
* Staying abreast of advancements in test automation tools and practices to recommend framework improvements
* Diagnosing and repairing intermediate complexity broken automation scripts with moderate guidance
* Assisting in the development of viable test strategies to support product functionality testing
* Creating comprehensive automated testing documentation, including test plans and reports
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:*** Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.

* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

title: Senior QA  Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**

Edgar Efile Solutions Pvt. Ltd is one of the prominent, energetic, and fastest growing companies in the industry.

The company was established in the year 2013 and playing a major role in providing financial reporting service like XBRL, Edgar and Typesetting services with 100% focus on quality within a strict timeline to US Clients.

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team and help us deliver high\-quality software products. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and AI\-driven testing solutions to ensure the functionality, performance, scalability, and reliability of our web applications. You will also collaborate with software developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to identify and resolve defects, improve testing processes, implement best practices, and drive intelligent test automation initiatives. 

**Responsibilities** 

· Develop test cases, test plans, test scripts, test data sets, or test procedures 

based on business requirements. 

· Report results of automated tests to development teams so that defects can be addressed before production release.

· Conduct post release audits to ensure that software is functioning properly in 

production environment.

· Perform load and performance tests using tools like JMeter or LoadRunner to check how well the system works and ensure scalability under high\-demand conditions.

· Perform manual testing on applications to identify bugs or defects in features.

· Coordinate with development teams to ensure that new features are thoroughly tested before deployment.

· Documenting acceptance criteria in user stories and tasks. 

**Requirements** 

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field 5\+ years of experience in QA automation engineering.

· Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.

· Experience with automation tools and frameworks such as **Selenium,**

**Playwright \& Cucumber**.

·Experience with web and mobile testing technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, or JSON. 

· Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or Mercurial is desirable.

· Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins is plus.

· Experience with agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

· Excellent presentation, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, with a strong attention to detail, quality, and accuracy is essential.

· Experience with AI\-driven testing methodologies and tools, including intelligent test automation, **automated test case generation**, self\-healing test scripts, defect prediction, **smart regression testing**, and AI\-based test analytics, is an added advantage.

Job Type: Full\-time

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
